tools.description: Get Athlete Stats - Returns the activity stats of an athlete. Only includes data from activities set to Everyone visibilty.
tools.name: getStats
tools.title: Get Athlete Stats

tools.description: Get Authenticated Athlete - Returns the currently authenticated athlete. Tokens with profile:read_all scope will receive a detailed athlete representation; all others will receive a summary representation.
tools.name: getLoggedInAthlete
tools.title: Get Authenticated Athlete

tools.description: List Starred Segments - List of the authenticated athlete's starred segments. Private segments are filtered out unless requested by a token with read_all scope.
tools.name: getLoggedInAthleteStarredSegments
tools.title: List Starred Segments

tools.description: List Segment Efforts - Returns a set of the authenticated athlete's segment efforts for a given segment.  Requires subscription.
tools.name: getEffortsBySegmentId
tools.title: List Segment Efforts

tools.description: Explore segments - Returns the top 10 segments matching a specified query.
tools.name: exploreSegments
tools.title: Explore segments

tools.description: Get Segment Effort - Returns a segment effort from an activity that is owned by the authenticated athlete. Requires subscription.
tools.name: getSegmentEffortById
tools.title: Get Segment Effort

tools.description: Get Club - Returns a given club using its identifier.
tools.name: getClubById
tools.title: Get Club

tools.description: List Club Members - Returns a list of the athletes who are members of a given club.
tools.name: getClubMembersById
tools.title: List Club Members

tools.description: List Club Administrators - Returns a list of the administrators of a given club.
tools.name: getClubAdminsById
tools.title: List Club Administrators

tools.description: List Club Activities - Retrieve recent activities from members of a specific club. The authenticated athlete must belong to the requested club in order to hit this endpoint. Pagination is supported. Athlete profile visibility is respected for all activities.
tools.name: getClubActivitiesById
tools.title: List Club Activities

tools.description: List Athlete Clubs - Returns a list of the clubs whose membership includes the authenticated athlete.
tools.name: getLoggedInAthleteClubs
tools.title: List Athlete Clubs

tools.description: Get Equipment - Returns an equipment using its identifier.
tools.name: getGearById
tools.title: Get Equipment

tools.description: List Athlete Routes - Returns a list of the routes created by the authenticated athlete. Private routes are filtered out unless requested by a token with read_all scope.
tools.name: getRoutesByAthleteId
tools.title: List Athlete Routes
